newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London close barely changed.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London close barely changed.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were barely changed on Monday in thin trading as concerns about the forthcoming UK budget subdued the market, dealers said.
By 1430 GMT the Nikkei/ISE 50 index was up 1.57 points, or 0.10 percent, at 1,620.45 points.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 climbed 152.72 points, or 0.74 percent, to finish on a new 1997 high of 20,681.07 points amid hopes that pension funds would step into the market soon.
"It's been a very quiet day apart from some profit- taking in Hitachi," one trader said.
Hitachi Corp. was up 30 yen at 1,292.5 yen. This compares to a close of 1,300 yen in Tokyo. TDK were down 90 yen to 8,310 yen.
